_about: What refs.py draft maps a CrossOver CrossTie or a Porting Kit .wsi3 recipe to, in Second Chance's Wrappfile syntax (docs/wrappfile.md).

An entry is a mapping: 'verbs' (winetricks verbs, each a WINE.WINETRICKS line), 'lines' (Wrappfile lines as written), 'launch' (LAUNCH options), 'uses' (modules the lines need), 'note' (said beside the line, or why there's nothing).

'noop': true says there's nothing to do, and that's fine (Wine's default, or the prefix has it already): draft says so in its header. An entry with none of verbs, lines or launch, and not noop, is a thing it can't map: draft lists it with its note. 'expand': true says to map the component's own dependencies instead.
Every verb must be one our winetricks has (Packages/Modules/wine/Sources/WineExecutor/Resources/winetricks); refs.py draft --check-map says which aren't.
Add to this as recipes show things it doesn't know.

windows-versions._about: CrossOver's bottletemplate, or a Porting Kit 'compatibility' / winetricks version verb, to our winetricks verb. _64 is the bottle's architecture: ours is always a 64-bit (WoW64) prefix.

win98.note: winetricks says win98 doesn't work in a 64-bit prefix, which ours is; try winxp, or an AppDefaults Version for the one program

win95.note: winetricks says win95 doesn't work in a 64-bit prefix, which ours is

crossover-components._about: A CrossTie dependency (predependency, postdependency), by its app id's number. 'name' is CrossOver's, for reading this file; draft prints the index's.

registry-keys._about: A registry key in full to the short name the wine module knows (WineExecutor.registryKey). Any other is written in full: never short, as an unknown short name means the X11 Driver key.

registry-unmapped._about: Keys whose values don't carry over, with why. Matched as a prefix of the key, case-insensitively.
registry-unmapped.HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\Software\\Wine\\Explo: a virtual desktop: a wrapp starts Wine's desktop itself (docs/wrapp-launch.md#wines-desktop)
registry-unmapped.HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\Software\\Wine\\TaskM: Wine's task manager's window: nothing to do with the program

registry-values._about: A value of one key that means something of ours instead. Key, then the value's name (lower case), then the data (lower case, or * for any).

*.note: the wine module's prefix-settings already sets EmulateModeset Y

pk-winetricks._about: A Porting Kit installWinetrick verb that means something other than itself to us. Any other verb our winetricks knows becomes a WINE.WINETRICKS line as it is.
